context: The lines occur immediately after a violent confrontation with a strange warrior named Lae'zel; the tieflings who faced her are reacting to her having been killed or mortally wounded. The speaker's one-word relief ("Dead. Finally.") reflects long-standing hostility or fear toward that foe and the end of the immediate threat. This moment can follow related combat in the wreckage (where a mind flayer had also been dealt with) and comes at a point where the player may have just chosen—or will be asked to choose—what to do with Lae'zel's body (let the tieflings take her, kill her, or lower her). The provided samples are only examples of how that immediate aftermath can play out.
